scope: Six exact tab/history command IDs; source analysis and adoption together.

facts.claim: undoAppAction defaults to Hoe(scope), is enabled by bde, and supplies a separate keyboardHandler through oMi/i5n. redoAppAction defaults to Ore(scope), is enabled by yLe, and supplies oMi/a5n. No command-local priority or isActive option is supplied for these two registrations.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: For a nonstandard undo/redo key oMi directly invokes the app-action fallback. For a standard key it first tries the supplied edit-history callback: exact true handles it; otherwise a focused other element, or composer with null result, returns false; all remaining cases invoke the app-action fallback.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Standard undo matching uses CmdOrCtrl+Z. Standard redo uses Command+Shift+Z under Qh(), otherwise Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z; these source key matches are separate from arbitrary configured shortcut bindings.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Composer edit history searches connected RP elements containing the active HTMLElement. Undo with hasText()===false returns false; otherwise the requested editHistory method result or null is returned. A non-HTMLElement or unmatched active element returns null.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The explicit I1t export used as initial.Hoe calls zLt(scope,undo). The command is an app-action history adapter, not browser or router back navigation.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The explicit F1t export used as initial.Ore calls zLt(scope,redo). Its return describes accepted history work rather than completion of the queued effect.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The M1t export used as bde derives undo availability solely from eI.length>0 in this selected definition. Effective mounting and winning command registration remain outside this source fact.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The j1t export used as yLe derives redo availability from tI.length>0. This is not evidence that a remote action, navigation or persistence result has succeeded.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: zLt selects the last ID from the chosen undo/redo list, returns false if absent, then looks up the entry in the scope-selected registry and delegates BLt when present.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: BLt rejects a side mismatch, a redo entry absent from tI, an expired committed entry, or a required navigation that cannot be prepared. Accepted work removes the entry from its visible side, assigns a request order, queues on transitionQueueKey, and returns true before waiting for completion.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The queued transition awaits the original completion Promise. Timed-out work calls the corresponding error callback; noncommitted or replaced entries do not run the effect. It awaits prepared navigation then undo/redo, catches effect errors for the corresponding callback, rechecks registry identity, moves the side and restores expiry. Undo alone adds the success toast; stale request order controls rearming/final cleanup.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The history registry is a WeakMap selected by qLt identity and contains entries, request ordering, redo invalidation order and transition tails. This source-scoped object is not proof of physical storage, cross-window identity or restart recovery.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: FLt creates a Symbol ID and pending entry with current location, appends it to undo history and installs the YLt pending timeout. Its returned handle exposes commit/discard/invalidate/undo/redo and dismiss handling. commit arms expiry only while the selected side remains present.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: QF settles a pending entry, cancels its pending timer, advances redo invalidation on committed/timed-out outcomes, recomputes redo visibility and resolves completion. Discard and timeout are distinct completion outcomes.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Redo visibility excludes entries invalidated through the recorded request order and entries older than pending-action ordering. Invalidated redo entries are finalized and removed; visible redo IDs are sorted by request order.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: GLt clears the prior expiry timer and uses dynamic expiration time when supplied, otherwise expiresAfterMs. Zero expiry finalizes immediately; otherwise a timeout delegates ZF. Neither this timer nor YLt establishes persistence.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: closeOtherTabs has an empty nMi fallback but a contextHandler. originPanel overrides current focus; bottom selects Wj and any other selected value chooses Uj. The active tab is read at invocation and its ID is kept while closeOtherTabs is delegated. isActive accepts supplied originPanel or bottom/right panel focus; no enabled option is supplied.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: reopenClosedTab is active only when current scope is not Qp and Xji is true. The callback chains Yji through a useRef Promise with then, serializing invocations, but returns no completion Promise and installs no rejection handler or ref reset in this callback.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Xji derives whether the scoped closed-record list Ezn has at least one item; it does not independently prove a restorable descriptor exists.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Yji pops the newest Ezn record before attempting restore. An empty list returns false; an unsupported kind is skipped recursively. It imports thread-panel-state, tries the original then opposite panel, caps the recorded index to the current tab count and requests start/after insertion with revealAndFocus=true, reason=closed-tab and isDisconnected returning false.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: A truthy descriptor-restore result alone is insufficient: Yji also checks the saved tabId exists in that panel controller before requesting activation and returning true. If neither panel succeeds it recursively tries older records. A caught exception re-adds the record through YRn, reports the error and returns false.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: ARn resolves a registered durableRoute and checks optional version. Its returned restorer requires payloadVersion match, waits while availability is undefined, and can return true for disconnection or unavailable capability. A loader may change the registry and retry; otherwise it delegates durableRoute.restore. Yji therefore retains its separate tab-presence check.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: YRn appends a closed record and keeps only the latest25 entries. Requeue on Yji error is capped rather than an unbounded rollback log.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: The selected Ezn initialization is fd(Mc,[]). The empty default and source-scoped key do not prove durable or cross-window history.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: previousTab and nextTab use empty Kyc/Gyc default callbacks but both provide contextHandler and keyboardHandler. They forward previous/next and optional originPanel to Hyc only when c8n is false; no selected enabled/priority/isActive option is supplied.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Hyc uses originPanel when supplied, otherwise focusArea. An enabled bottom-panel case directly delegates Wj.activateAdjacentTab without a local length guard. With no workspace NS, right-focus or CS, EC and more than one right tab are all required before Uj activation.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: When a workspace NS exists, Hyc requires it visible and either full mode or right-panel focus, then calls workspace.selectAdjacentTab. It does not fall back to the nonworkspace right-panel branch merely because the existing workspace is hidden.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Wj is built by XRn for bottom with wC open signal and pC setter. This identifies a concrete panel facade; method guards, close confirmation, state writes and effective physical authority remain at the existing controller boundary.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: Uj is built by XRn for right with EC, singleTab=false and its own open/close setter. These source inputs differ from bottom; equal method names do not justify flattening both controllers.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation

facts.claim: HP maps bottom to Wj and other input to Uj; the dynamic barrel exports this existing initial definition as getThreadPanelTabController via apn.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST and scoped declaration/reference review; no target code evaluation
